The woman who had rightly understood my crimes, and promised me their rightful punishment.

I wanted to protect her, whatever else I must give!

en.html:
With sheer will, I drove the fog out of my head. Looked fiercely upward and caught the enemy in sight.

Fight.
Get up... fight!

That irreplaceable person—
Captain Ootori. To protect her!

...But Kageaki Minato.
This you had already understood, had you not?

                  The fate written in your star.

Not once had you protected anyone precious. Not even once.

Kageaki Minato was a man with no power to protect anyone.
That was the truth.
